name: Power Word Kill

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A creature with 100 HP or fewer dies outright; a tougher one takes 12d12 Psychic damage.
text: No save: if the target you can see has 100 Hit Points or fewer, it dies. Otherwise it takes 12d12 Psychic damage.
